description: Builds ZAISRV (*SRVPGM: get/reserve/release, solutions/07-05/zaisrv.rpgle + zaisrv.bnd) and a new ZAISRVBD (*BNDDIR) - kept separate from JUCSRVBD per the source's own driver.rpgle design (design doc's open §9 item 10 on JUCSRVBD-vs-ZAISRVBD reuse is left unresolved by this manifest; this reflects what the committed driver.rpgle source actually references). Compiles and runs driver.rpgle ONCE - per the design's own corrected understanding (ileconcepts75.txt: a system-named ACTGRP(*NEW) activation group is deleted the instant its oldest call-stack entry returns), every one of driver.rpgle's test steps (normal reserve, a SHORT reserve exercising the lock-release fix, a same-execution double-reserve for lock-carryover, and its own independent lock-conflict diagnostic) MUST happen inside this single CALL - never split across two separate CALL steps, which would each get an unrelated fresh activation group and could never observe anything about lock persistence either way. IMPORTANT SIDE EFFECT: this mutates the shared ZAIKOM table (same table R0409A/F0608A already write to) - per this repo's established convention (see part06-0508-procs-files/manifest.json's own note), this manifest deliberately does NOT run TXRESET itself; whoever runs this batch must follow it with the TXRESET *CMD (not CALL PGM(TXRESET)) before relying on ZAIKOM's known values again (04-13, 06-07's exercise, 06-11b, and 06-15's checkpoint all depend on them).

steps.label: CPZAISSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/ZAISRV) MODULE(&LIB/ZAISRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZAISBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJ((*LIBL/ZAISRV *SRVPGM))
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: REMINDER
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('part07-05-checkpoint DONE - TXRESET has NOT been run, ZAIKOM P00001 is left decremented, run the TXRESET *CMD before relying on ZAIKOM again') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
